newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: MUSIC to offer stock on NASDAQ.
newsitem.headline: MUSIC to offer stock on NASDAQ.

text.p: MUSIC Semiconductors Corp said on Monday its board has approved a planned offering of its shares in the U.S. NASDAQ electronic stock market possibly by September this year.
In a letter to the Philippine Stock Exchange, legal counsel Jimmy Soo said the company would sell not more than 100 million shares to foreign investors which would generate about $60 million.
The board also approved the increase of its authorised capital stock to 500 million pesos from the present 400 million pesos.
Thirty to fifty percent of the offering would be comprised of secondary shares, Soo said.
U.S. brokerage firm Alex Brown and Sons has been appointed as the lead underwriter for the offering.
"The timing of the offering, subject to U.S. financial markets environment, (will) be around September 1997," Soo added.
MUSIC manufactures and distributes computer network systems.
